finding: Brain-type boss telegraphs each spit as a cube that flies to a round-robin spot; flight time is set at launch from distance over speed; on landing it shows fog then spawns a weighted minion (11 types, weights of 256). Idea is STRONG; defects in the note (divide by zero on momentum and spot count, unbounded 32-entry spot array, static easy toggle, lost fan nudge), keep idea and fix each.

Boss-death gate: requires a living player, then scans for another alive boss of the same type; if none, runs the map's tagged event or exits. Per type, so on the commercial map 7 each boss type fires its own event. Adapt as a zone-tag gate that the server decides.

Death chain: 100-tic scream row of 65 blast puffs across 512 units, then two 10-tic holds, then exit (about 3.4 s). Order is staged visual first, exit last; a model for a bearable win or loss on a phone.

Wake is one sound, then 181 tics (5.2 s) before the first spit and 150 tics (4.3 s) between spits. Walkers play a footfall sound on specific walk frames (metal on the spider, hoof on the cyberdemon), so the approach is heard before it is seen. Readability: no threat colour and no cap on cube spawns in this code.

Fan volley: two missiles per attack at aim plus 11.25, aim minus 22.5, or plus and minus 5.625 degrees. Cyberdemon and spider take no splash damage. Pain chance per hit out of 256: cyberdemon 20, spider 40, bruiser 50, brain 255. No dragons, breath cones, flight phases, taming or mounts in this donor (grep of the whole linuxdoom-1.10 tree); no HP phases; only the cube is a summon, with no cap or upkeep.

No boss monsters in this tree: the single-player monsters and bosses are absent (no monsters.qc, grep found no boss code). Only the client end-of-level path is here: svc_intermission, svc_finale and svc_cutscene set state 1, 2 or 3, centre text types at 8 characters per second, and the camera idles full-screen. The server writer of svc_finale is not in the tree. Verdict PARTIAL. Best idea: the finale card typed from a server event.

Level-name table has 38 entries (start, 8 in episode 1, 7 in episode 2, 7 in episode 3, 8 in episode 4, the final level, 6 deathmatch levels). Titles are the donor's; the grammar (episode prefix and a place name) is the idea, not the names.

Lightning beam lives 0.2 s and stays up only while the server re-sends it for the same entity; explosion light radius 350, decay 300, life 0.5 s. Partial idea for a mage-type lightning spell. Armour absorbs a fraction of damage (0.3, 0.6, 0.8), save equals ceil(fraction times damage), capped at the armour value. No dragons, breath, flight, taming or mounts anywhere in the tree (grep).

Door data (speed 100, wait 3 seconds default, wait -1 for key doors, lip 8, damage 2) is the data a boss-locked door would need. Half read: client C (WinQuake) and QuakeWorld QuakeC (server data), not the single-player progs.
